chapters/ch5.1: Little Heesu only has the 「Discarded Plank」 she picked up next to Dad's factory. On the first run of Chapter 5, STAGE 17–18 must be played with the plank as your weapon. (Inside Chapter 5, a memory bonus makes it as strong as your best weapon.) Take it and go now?
chapters/ch5.2: You need a 「Discarded Plank」 to enter Chapter 5. You can buy one from the Delivery App for {v1}G. Go buy it now?
chapters/ch5.3: The 「Discarded Plank」 became the 「Wooden Sword of Memories」!
chapters/ch5.5: Oppa, did you pack the passports? The charger? Sunscreen?
chapters/ch5.6: Yep, sounds good! All packed. Fishing rod too!
chapters/ch5.7: ……Why are you packing a fishing rod.
chapters/ch5.8: You never know… if we see the sea…
chapters/ch5.10: After the great suitcase war… her eyelids grow heavier, and heavier…
chapters/ch5.11: …When she opened her eyes, she was in a strangely familiar alley. Everything felt soft and hazy, like a dream.
chapters/ch5.12: Huh…? Isn't this the alley next to Dad's factory?
chapters/ch5.13: My hands… got tiny?! I'm a kid again!
chapters/ch5.14: Heesu~ let's play hide-and-seek! You're it!
chapters/ch5.16: Big bros~? Where are you hiding…?
chapters/ch5.17: Wandering the alleys looking for the boys… she got lost.
chapters/ch5.18: Where… am I…? Bori… where did Bori go…?
chapters/ch5.20: The alley shadows start to wriggle!
chapters/ch5.21: I-I'm not scared! I've got… the plank I found by the factory!
chapters/ch5.22: She finally found her way out of the alley. Over there… Dad's woodshop!
chapters/ch5.24: Oh ho, my Heesu's here? I told you it's dangerous at Dad's work~
chapters/ch5.25: Daddy, I found this plank! It's trash, right?
chapters/ch5.26: Yep, a leftover. Watch out for splinters.
chapters/ch5.27: But… Dad's eyes keep drifting to the sea outside the window.
chapters/ch5.28: ……Maybe I'll go to the fishing pier this weekend… heard the black porgy are biting…
chapters/ch5.29: Dad's fishing thoughts burst out as phantoms!
chapters/ch5.30: Daddy! You were thinking about fishing instead of working!
chapters/ch5.32: ……Why is every man in my life obsessed with fishing.
chapters/ch5.33: Stop bothering Daddy's work! I'll scold you all!
chapters/ch5.34: After Dad finished work, she met the big bros again at the empty lot.
chapters/ch5.35: Heesu, where'd you go! Let's have a sword fight!
chapters/ch5.36: The boys all have cool wooden swords.
chapters/ch5.37: …I'm the only one without a sword. This is just… a plank…
chapters/ch5.38: Heesu, want to give that to Daddy for a sec?
chapters/ch5.39: Shff, shff— Dad shapes the plank with a plane and sandpaper.
chapters/ch5.40: The 「Discarded Plank」 became the 「Wooden Sword of Memories」!
chapters/ch5.42: There, a sword just for my Heesu. Don't hurt your hands.
chapters/ch5.43: (From now on you can switch to other weapons. The wooden sword is Transcendent, same tier as the MacBook Pro, so it gets stronger as you enhance it!)
chapters/ch5.45: Oh, you got a sword? Then bring it on!
chapters/ch5.46: Get ready, big bros! I won't go easy!
chapters/ch5.47: The sun is setting. The sword fight was a total win for Heesu!
chapters/ch5.48: Heesu's so strong… let's do it again tomorrow!
chapters/ch5.50: ……Tomorrow? Wasn't I supposed to do something tomorrow…?
chapters/ch5.52: On the way home, the tick-tock grows louder and louder.
chapters/ch5.53: 5 more minutes~ It's still dawn~ Keep dreaming~
chapters/ch5.54: No! I have to go on my honeymoon!!!
chapters/ch5.55: With the sword Daddy made me… I'm going home!
chapters/ch5.58: Heesu, wake up! Our flight's in three hours!
chapters/ch5.59: Oppa… I had a dream. Playing with the big bros by Dad's factory when I was little.
chapters/ch5.61: A small wooden sword is clutched in Heesu's hand.
chapters/ch5.63: Dad made it for me. …I should call Dad when we get back from the trip.
chapters/ch5.64: Sounds good! …But do I really have to leave the fishing rod?
chapters/ch5.66: Next: Chapter 6, the honeymoon at last!
chapters/ch5.69: Chapter 5 · A Dream the Night Before the Honeymoon
chapters/ch5.114: Ring ring… as if! Sleep more~
chapters/ch5.117: A scrap of wood tossed out by Dad's factory. In Chapter 5 (childhood), a memory bonus makes it as strong as your best weapon · Can't be sold, traded, or dismantled
chapters/ch5.119: A sword Dad shaped for Heesu with a plane and sandpaper. Transcendent, same tier as the MacBook Pro · Can't be sold, traded, or dismantled
chapters/ch5.128: Prologue · The Night Before the Honeymoon
chapters/ch5.133:
Hide-and-seek 1 · Sword fight total win
{lv}

With the wooden sword Dad made, off to the real honeymoon!
To be continued in Chapter 6…
chapters/ch5.134: Back to that alley once more
chapters/ch5.135: The fishing rod quietly left the suitcase…
chapters/ch5.136: Haaam~ packing wore me out… Oppa, lights off, let's sleep.
chapters/ch5.137: Yeah! Sounds good! We need to sleep early for the flight tomorrow~
chapters/ch5.138: Click. The lights go out… tick, tock. Only the clock can be heard.
chapters/ch5.139: (Airport tomorrow… what time was it… passport, packed… fishing rod… taken out…)
chapters/ch5.141: (…mm… somewhere… the smell of a summer long ago…)
chapters/ch5.143: Heesu~ where are you~? Come play~!
chapters/ch5.144: Huh…? Someone's calling… I know that voice…
chapters/ch5.145: She feels herself getting smaller… the dream carries her far, far back in time.
chapters/ch5.147: It IS a dream! A dream of the alley I played in as a kid!
